card.name: Just before RNA polymerase and reverse transcriptase
card.fires_on: The word just before a polymerase or transcriptase enzyme name, such as 'called' before RNA polymerase, 'reverse' before transcriptase, or 'RNA' before an RNA enzyme.

modes.label: Reverse before transcriptase
modes.description: The word 'reverse' (or the end of 'nucleoside') in reverse transcriptase inhibitor class names.
modes.example: respiratory depression. Examples : Rifampin, carbamazepine, phenytoin Antiretrovirals: Non-nucleoside<< reverse>> transcriptase inhibitors (NNRTIs)

modes.label: Called before an enzyme name
modes.description: The word 'called' introducing an enzyme such as RNA polymerase or telomerase.
modes.example: nucleosomes open to expose the part of the chromosomal DNA where the gene for that protein is located. This allows an enzyme<< called>> RNA polymerase II to contact the gene
